proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#18

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Close friend who, under Hive's sway, chokes Fitz as a warning.

their_evidence: The Singularity (S3#18): Hive and Daisy go to Bucharest; Daisy uses her powers on Fitz, choking him, to say she does not want to be rescued and that there will be no other warning.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: May's trainee.

their_evidence: Ascension (S3#22): Hive captures Daisy and takes her aboard Zephyr One; May and Fitz secretly board the plane and find and free her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson recruits Daisy Johnson into S.H.I.E.L.D. and becomes a father figure to her. She grows from a hacker on his plane into one of his most trusted agents.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's recruiter and father figure, who makes her one of his top agents.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's recruit and like a daughter to him, one of his most trusted agents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
stages.text: The dying Coulson refuses the serum that could save him and hides it in Daisy's gauntlets so she can stop Talbot. He then says goodbye and leaves to spend his last days in Tahiti.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's recruiter and father figure. Gives up his cure so she can win, then says goodbye.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's recruit and like a daughter to him. He gives up his cure so she can stop Talbot.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#21
proposed.text: Coulson visits Daisy in containment as she comes off Hive's hold. She calls herself a brainwashed criminal like Ward, and he puts it down to withdrawal.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's father figure, who refuses to see her as a criminal.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's recruit, who blames herself for serving Hive.

their_evidence: Absolution (S3#21): in the Playground, Coulson updates Daisy in her containment module; she says she is no better than Grant Ward, a brainwashed criminal, and Coulson dismisses it as withdrawal from her addiction.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#19
stages.text: Glenn Talbot works with Jemma and the team at the Lighthouse until his obsession with Gravitonium takes over. He shoots her with an I.C.E.R. so he can climb into the Particle Infusion Chamber and take its power for himself.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Scientist Talbot works with, then shoots with an I.C.E.R. to seize Gravitonium.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: General who works with the team, then shoots Jemma with an I.C.E.R. for Gravitonium.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#20
proposed.text: Simmons briefs Talbot on Hive's plans and, while he watches, confirms that Daisy is free of Hive's control.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Scientist who briefs Talbot on Hive and clears Daisy.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: General whom Jemma briefs on Hive's plans.

their_evidence: Emancipation (S3#20): in Coulson's office Simmons explains to Talbot that Hive has the Kree blood and Terrigen he needs; later Talbot watches Simmons treat Daisy and she confirms Daisy is safe.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: General who tries to bribe Hunter into betraying Coulson.

their_evidence: The Inside Man (S3#12): at the Playground Talbot clashes with Hunter, who despises Creel for the deaths of Isabelle Hartley and Idaho; Talbot says it was Whitehall's brainwashing.

stages.on_a_card_about_b: Agent who saves Talbot from Creel, then helps kidnap him.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: General who offers May condolences for her fallen agents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Gravitonium-powered general who forces May to surrender aboard Qovas' ship.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: General whose kidnapped son May finds.

their_evidence: The Inside Man (S3#12): May and Lincoln bring down Creel thinking he targets Talbot; at the symposium May locates George Talbot in suspension gel and the group escapes with him.
